title: Minimax Quantum State Tomography in a Known Trace-Distance Ball
summary: We study quantum state tomography when the unknown state lies in a trace-distance ball of radius $R$ around a known reference state $ρ$. For arbitrary collective measurements, we determine the minimax expected risk and confidence radius up to universal constants, uniformly over the dimension, center spectrum, radius, and sample size. Write $Γ=d(\mathrm{Tr}\sqrtρ)^2+d^2R$. For $d\ge2$, $0 0$, the copy complexity is $Θ((Γ+\log(1/δ))/\varepsilon^2)$.
